blockers.description: Intermittent proxy SSL handshake failures when vcpkg downloads GitHub archives; the current missing archive is boostorg-tti-boost-1.90.0.tar.gz.
blockers.workaround: Read the boost-tti versioned portfile for its exact REF and SHA512, download the matching codeload.github.com archive through http://127.0.0.1:7890 into D:\vcpkg\vcpkg\downloads, verify SHA512, then rerun RestoreServers.

decisions.decision: Use dynamic CRT and dynamic third-party libraries by default, with mysql-connector-cpp and libmysql static in the custom x64-windows-chat triplet.
decisions.rationale: The pinned mysql-connector-cpp JDBC feature is static-only; this keeps all other dependencies and deployment app-local behavior aligned with the desired dynamic baseline.

decisions.decision: Use D:\vcpkg\test-vcpkg as the complete pinned registry checkout while preserving D:\vcpkg\vcpkg.
decisions.rationale: The old checkout is shallow and cannot resolve the pinned baseline, but its downloads, installed tree and binary cache remain useful for reuse.

decisions.decision: Place vcpkg buildtrees and packages on C: and clean them after every port.
decisions.rationale: The first gRPC attempt filled D:. Moving regenerable temporary data to C: allowed gRPC to finish without deleting the old installation or final project dependencies.
